title: ze_dreamin
description: Four levels of light and crystal bosses: the Crystal and its blade room (Fade), the Puny Light and the final laser climb (Dream), the Giant and Final Light (3), and the arena, the Light and the surf lasers (4).

scenarios.name: Level 1 ending (full): Crystal → blade room → elevator
scenarios.summary: Crystal boss, blade room, then the elevator
scenarios.description: From the Crystal's teleport (boss_teleport, +50 hits per human) through its 8 segments, back to the teleport place, the blade room (Final Crystal, +70 hits per human) and the rising floor out. Win when a human reaches clear_trigger (score).

scenarios.name: Crystal (boss)
scenarios.summary: A chasing crystal casting gravity, wind, ice
scenarios.description: boss_teleport adds 50 hits per human to HPCounter2; boss_relay starts the fight 7 s later. The crystal chases the nearest human on thrusters (80 damage on touch) and every 10–15 s casts Gravity, Thruster, Wind or Ice. 8 segments; at +140 s st1_fail breaks the floor.

scenarios.name: Gravity
scenarios.summary: Resist the pull toward the crystal
scenarios.description: boss_g: four 200 u/s pushes on the crystal's corners pull you in toward it for 2.5 s (boss_hurt: 80 on touch).

scenarios.name: Thruster
scenarios.summary: Stay off it: it launches you up
scenarios.description: boss_up: for 1 s, touching it throws you up at 700 u/s.

scenarios.name: Wind
scenarios.summary: Wind pushes you toward the edge
scenarios.description: wind_random: one of two 350 u/s pushes (east or west) across the arena for 2.5 s; the floor edge is the drop.

scenarios.name: Ice
scenarios.summary: An ice blast that slows and hurts
scenarios.description: boss_ice: a 2112 x 2112 field for 1 s: 15 damage and speed 0.1 for 4 s.

scenarios.name: Level 1 finale
scenarios.summary: Final Crystal's blades, the rising floor, then the blades from below
scenarios.description: boss_to_blade2 adds 70 hits per human to blade_hp (start 50) and teleports you into the blade room, facing the Final Crystal. Walking in, the first human through the trigger 1100 u in starts blade_start_timer: a blade flies out of the crystal every 2 s at 1700 u/s, low (jump), mid (jump) or high (crouch), 999999 damage; each human one kills takes 60 off the crystal. When it breaks, first_win: final_floor rises 3200 u (500 u/s) 9 s after a human steps on it; at the top, blades fly up from blade_rotate below (look down) for 8.5 s, clear_trigger opens at +9.5 s, NUKE at +12 s. Win at score.

scenarios.name: Level 2 ending (full): Puny Light → final climb
scenarios.summary: Puny Light boss, then the final climb
scenarios.description: From the snow elevator's teleport into the arena (+5000 HP per human on st2_hitbox, 1500 base) through the 118 s fight, then st2_final_relay's 128 s climb: stone walk at +90 s, the final lasers at +108 s, the teleport up at +120 s. Win at score_trigger.

scenarios.name: Puny Light (boss)
scenarios.summary: Break the Light through six shuffled attacks
scenarios.description: st2_start: a phase every 14 s (shuffled: Spread out, Zombie way, Danger Field, For Upper, Laser, Spikes) and 118 s to break st2_hitbox (1500 + 5000 per human; grenades 100 each), else fail_nuke. 200 damage touching it.

scenarios.name: Spread out
scenarios.summary: Weave through spinning bullet trains
scenarios.description: b_timer: every 0.08 s for 12 s b_maker (on the spinning b_rotate) sends out two bullet trains (65 damage); at +7.5 s it switches to the second pattern.

scenarios.name: Danger Field
scenarios.summary: Leave the quarter that lights up
scenarios.description: random_hurt_timer: every 4 s for 12 s one arena quarter lights up, then burns (50) 1–3 s later.

scenarios.name: For Upper
scenarios.summary: Lifted up, then dodge sweeping lasers
scenarios.description: s2_upper lifts everyone to the upper platform (boss_upper) for 2 s; at +3 s the platform breaks and six 150-damage lasers (laserhurt) sweep the levels until +9 s.

scenarios.name: Laser
scenarios.summary: Jump wide lasers sweeping from the sides
scenarios.description: bladerandom_timer: every 3.5 s for 12 s a 2176-wide laser (200 damage, 2000 u/s) sweeps in from one of the four sides.

scenarios.name: Spikes
scenarios.summary: Dodge spikes raining from above
scenarios.description: spike_timer: every 0.12 s for 12 s three spikes (100 damage) drop from the makers riding the SETH_Ramdon3 track.

scenarios.name: Level 2 final lasers
scenarios.summary: Bridges up, one breaks, lasers off the other
scenarios.description: st2_final_relay +106 s, on the platform between the two stone walks (stone_walk_1 / 2: they start invisible, appear at +90 s), facing stone_walk_1. The first human on test_laser (enabled +108 s) picks a side 2 s later (finalaser_random): the other stone walk breaks, and for 9 s vertical lasers and sweeping lasers (999999) come off the walk that stays. st2_upper teleports humans to the end at +120 s; score_trigger opens at +128 s.

scenarios.name: Level 3 ending (full): Giant Light → Final Light
scenarios.summary: Giant Light, then the Final Light run
scenarios.description: From st3_goto (+600 hits per human on st3_hp) through the Giant Light's 250 s (phases, totems, the defense hold at +115 s, phase 2 at +180 s), the floor out, the final run (final_relay) and the Final Light at +110 s. Win at st3_clear (+143 s).

scenarios.name: Giant Light (boss)
scenarios.summary: A long boss fight with shuffled phases
scenarios.description: st3_goto drops each human into a corner of the arena and adds 600 hits per human; st3_boss_start (+5 s). A phase every 13 s (shuffled: two Ice, Crouch, Wind, Upline, Explosions, Line lasers), a Reflection one time in eight every 15 s (shooting it then costs you 10 per hit), totems every 10–14 s. 250 s, else st3_fail.

scenarios.name: Ice
scenarios.summary: Jump the spinning ice bar
scenarios.description: st3_ice: the spinning ice bar (5 damage, speed 0.1 for 3 s) from +0.5 s to +8 s.

scenarios.name: Crouch field
scenarios.summary: Crouch under the damage plane
scenarios.description: st3_crouch: a 2560 x 2560 plane of 40 damage across the arena for 8 s.

scenarios.name: Wind
scenarios.summary: Hold your ground against diagonal wind
scenarios.description: st3_wind_random: one of four 320 u/s diagonal pushes for 9 s.

scenarios.name: Upline
scenarios.summary: Dodge lines rising from the floor
scenarios.description: upline_timer: every 0.4 s for 10 s a line (60 damage) rises 2000 u from a point riding the SETH_Ramdon2 track; upline_hurt slows you to 0.8 for 2 s.

scenarios.name: Explosions
scenarios.summary: Shoot or dodge the dropped bombs
scenarios.description: explo_timer: every 0.2–0.3 s for 10 s explo_maker on the spinning explo_maker_rot drops a bomb (160) that blows when shot or touched.

scenarios.name: Line lasers
scenarios.summary: Jump line lasers from every direction
scenarios.description: linelaser_timer: every 1 s for 10 s one of 25 grid makers sends a 2944-wide line laser (80) in one of four directions.

scenarios.name: Final Light (boss) + corridor
scenarios.summary: Kill the Final Light, run the corridor
scenarios.description: final_relay +109 s: the push (110–114 s) throws you into the room and adds 50 hits per human; the light takes bullets from +114 s and its lasers (3 heights, every 1–1.2 s) and pillars come at you. Dead by +128 s or final_fail_1. Then the corridor lasers (+130.5–141 s) and st3_clear at +143 s.

scenarios.name: Level 4 (full): arena → Light → surf
scenarios.summary: Arena attacks, the Light, then the surf
scenarios.description: rtv_relay from the arena (+50 s, 222 HP from rtv_enter_1): random attacks every 14 s until +133 s, the Light at +160 s (+100 hits per human, 24 s), then the surf with lasers to rtv_last. Win when rtv_endnuke comes on.

scenarios.name: Arena attacks
scenarios.summary: Survive five shuffled arena attacks
scenarios.description: rtv_first_timer: every 14 s from +50 to +133 s one of five (shuffled): Lasers, Thrusters, Ice, Danger Fields, Bombs. Falling off is 200 and rtv_teleport_case puts you back in a corner.

scenarios.name: Lasers
scenarios.summary: Dodge laser pillars running across
scenarios.description: rtv_laser_timer: every 0.1 s for 13 s a laser pillar (50, slows zombies) spawns where SETH_Ramdon_Maker is on its back-and-forth tracks and runs across.

scenarios.name: Thrusters
scenarios.summary: Avoid the pads that fling you out
scenarios.description: rtv_th_timer: every 0.08 s for 13 s a pad (rtv_th) that throws you 400 u/s out and up.

scenarios.name: Ice
scenarios.summary: Jump the sweeping ice bar
scenarios.description: rtv_ice_relay: the ice bar (50, speed 0.5) sweeps for 13 s, stopping at +7 s and reversing at +9 s.

scenarios.name: Danger fields
scenarios.summary: Leave the quarter before it burns
scenarios.description: rtv_field_case at 0/3/6/9 s: one quarter (1024 x 1024) burns 70 for 3 s after a 1 s warning.

scenarios.name: Bombs
scenarios.summary: Stay clear of the walking bombs
scenarios.description: SETH_BOMB_MAKER x3: walking bombs (180) that pick a direction, walk and explode; their makers are removed at +13 s.

scenarios.name: Light (boss)
scenarios.summary: Dodge the Light's lasers and pillars
scenarios.description: rtv_relay +160 s: rtv_teleport_2 lands you on the heal pad at rtv_des_3 (+300 HP, +100 hits per human on rtv_linelaser_count, start 10). For 24 s the wall-wide light fires line lasers (175) and pillars (200, half speed) every 1–1.5 s; each human they touch takes 70 off it. Dead at +185 s or rtv_nuke_1.

scenarios.name: Surf lasers
scenarios.summary: Surf to the end past the lasers
scenarios.description: After the Light: rtv_compare_1 sends humans to rtv_des_4 and starts rtv_surflaser_timer (every 0.8–1 s one of five heights, 999999). Ride the trigger_push (sv_airaccelerate 1000) to rtv_last; rtv_endnuke 25 s after the push.
